concepts.title: 過去式
concepts.summary: 昨天做了什麼？說過去的事，動詞要變身。

questions.q: go 的過去式是哪一個？
questions.e: go → went（過去式）→ gone（過去分詞）。

questions.q: Yesterday I ___ soccer with my friends.
h: Yesterday 是昨天，說的是過去。
questions.e: 說過去的事用過去式：play → played。

questions.q: eat 的過去式是哪一個？
questions.e: eat → ate → eaten。

questions.q: 「Did you watch TV last night?」如果有，要怎麼回答？
h: 用 Did 問，就用 did 答。
questions.e: Did you ...? → Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.

questions.q: 下列哪一個是表示「過去」的時間？
h: tomorrow 和 next week 是未來。
questions.e: last Sunday 上星期日（過去）；tomorrow 明天、next week 下星期（未來）。

questions.q: see 的過去式是哪一個？
questions.e: see → saw → seen。

questions.q: buy 的過去式是哪一個？
h: brought 是 bring 的過去式喔。
questions.e: buy → bought；bring → brought，兩個很像別搞混。

questions.q: She ___ to the park last Sunday.
h: last Sunday 是過去的時間。
questions.e: 說過去的事用過去式：go → went。

questions.q: I didn't ___ my homework yesterday.
questions.e: didn't 後面接原形動詞：didn't do。

questions.q: 「Where did you go yesterday?」最適合的回答是哪一個？
questions.e: 用 did 問過去的事，回答用過去式：I went to the zoo.

questions.q: study 的過去式是哪一個？
h: 子音 + y 結尾的動詞……
要把 y 改成 i 再加 ed。
questions.e: study → studied（y 改 i 加 ed）。

questions.q: stop 的過去式是 stoped。
h: 短母音 + 一個子音結尾……
要重複最後一個字母再加 ed。
questions.e: stop → stopped，要重複 p 再加 ed。

concepts.title: 短文閱讀
concepts.summary: 先讀「」裡的短文，再回答問題；答案都藏在短文裡。

questions.q: 「Mia has a dog. His name is Lucky. He is brown and white.」What color is Lucky?
questions.e: He is brown and white. → Lucky 是咖啡色和白色。

questions.q: 「Ben gets up at six. He rides his bike to school.」How does Ben go to school?
questions.e: He rides his bike to school. → 騎腳踏車上學。

questions.q: 「It is cold today. Amy wears a coat and a hat.」What is the weather like today?
h: 所以 Amy 穿了外套。
questions.e: It is cold today. → 今天很冷。

questions.q: 「Kevin's birthday is on May 5. He wants a new ball.」When is Kevin's birthday?
questions.e: Kevin's birthday is on May 5. → 五月五日。

questions.q: 「Lily likes fruit. She eats an apple every morning.」What does Lily eat every morning?
h: 找 every morning 那一句。
questions.e: She eats an apple every morning. → 每天早上吃一顆蘋果。

questions.q: 「There are four people in my family: my dad, my mom, my brother and me.」How many people are there in the family?
h: 數一數冒號後面有幾個人。
questions.e: 爸爸、媽媽、哥哥（或弟弟）和我，一共四個人。

questions.q: 「Last Sunday, Jack went to the zoo. He saw a big elephant.」Where did Jack go last Sunday?
questions.e: Jack went to the zoo. → 去了動物園。

questions.q: 「Sara is good at drawing. She wants to be an artist.」What does Sara want to be?
questions.e: She wants to be an artist. → 她想當畫家。

questions.q: 「The bookstore opens at nine in the morning and closes at eight at night.」When does the bookstore close?
questions.e: closes at eight at night → 晚上八點關門。

questions.q: 「Tom was sick yesterday, so he stayed home.」Why did Tom stay home?
questions.e: Tom was sick, so he stayed home. → 因為生病所以待在家。

questions.q: 「My sister is ten. I am twelve. My brother is eight.」Who is the youngest?
questions.e: 8 歲最小，所以 my brother 最年輕。

questions.q: 「Peter likes music. He plays the piano after dinner.」What does Peter do after dinner?
questions.e: He plays the piano after dinner. → 晚餐後彈鋼琴。

concepts.title: was 和 were
concepts.summary: am、is 的過去式是 was；are 的過去式是 were。

questions.q: I ___ at home yesterday.
h: I 搭配 am，am 的過去式是……
questions.e: I + was，說昨天在家。

questions.q: They ___ happy last night.
h: They 搭配 are，過去式是……
questions.e: They + were。

questions.q: She ___ sick last week.
h: She 搭配 is，過去式是……
questions.e: She + was。

questions.q: ___ you at school yesterday?
questions.e: you 的過去 be 動詞是 were：Were you at school yesterday?

questions.q: 「Was he tired?」如果是，要怎麼回答？
h: 用 Was 問，就用 was 答。
questions.e: Was he ...? → Yes, he was. / No, he wasn't.

questions.q: We ___ in Tainan last summer.
h: We 搭配 are，過去式是……
questions.e: We + were。

questions.q: am 和 is 的過去式是哪一個？
questions.e: am、is → was；are → were。

questions.q: are 的過去式是哪一個？
questions.e: are → were。

questions.q: The weather ___ sunny yesterday.
questions.e: 單數主詞 + was：The weather was sunny.

questions.q: 「Were they at the park?」如果不是，要怎麼回答？
h: 用 Were 問，就用 were 答。
questions.e: Were they ...? → No, they weren't.

questions.q: 「I were late this morning.」這句話文法正確。
questions.e: 應該是 I was late this morning.

questions.q: My shoes ___ dirty after the game.
questions.e: 複數主詞 + were：My shoes were dirty.

concepts.title: 未來式 will／be going to
concepts.summary: 說未來要做的事：will + 原形動詞，或 be going to + 原形動詞。

questions.q: I ___ visit my grandma tomorrow.
questions.e: will + 原形動詞，表示未來：I will visit my grandma.

questions.q: We are going to ___ a movie tonight.
h: be going to 後面接什麼？
questions.e: be going to + 原形動詞：are going to watch。

questions.q: She ___ going to swim this weekend.
h: She 搭配哪個 be 動詞？
be going to 的 be 要跟主詞變化。
questions.e: She is going to swim.

questions.q: 下列哪一個是表示「未來」的時間？
questions.e: next Monday 下星期一（未來）。

questions.q: 「Will it rain tomorrow?」如果會，要怎麼回答？
h: 用 Will 問，就用 will 答。
questions.e: Will it ...? → Yes, it will. / No, it won't.

questions.q: 「What are you going to do this weekend?」最適合的回答是哪一個？
h: 問的是 this weekend 要做什麼。
回答也要用 be going to。
questions.e: 用 be going to 問，就用 be going to 答。

questions.q: won't 是哪兩個字的縮寫？
questions.e: won't = will not。

questions.q: I want to be a doctor ___.
questions.e: in the future 將來。

questions.q: 「He will goes to school tomorrow.」這句話文法正確。
questions.e: will 後面接原形動詞：He will go to school tomorrow.

questions.q: 「明天我要去爬山。」英文要怎麼說？
questions.a: I'm going to climb a mountain tomorrow.
w: I going to climb a mountain tomorrow.
h: be going to + 原形動詞，be 動詞別漏掉。
questions.e: I'm going to + 原形動詞 + tomorrow。

questions.q: 「What will you do tomorrow?」「I ___ clean my room.」
questions.e: I will clean my room. 明天會打掃房間。

questions.q: Tom ___ going to buy a new bike next month.
h: next month 是未來，用 be going to。
questions.e: Tom is going to buy a new bike.

concepts.title: 最高級
concepts.summary: 三個以上比較，用 the + 最高級：tall → the tallest。

questions.q: tall 的最高級是哪一個？
questions.e: tall → taller → tallest。

questions.q: big 的最高級是哪一個？
h: 短母音 + 一個子音結尾。
questions.e: big → bigger → biggest。

questions.q: happy 的最高級是哪一個？
h: y 改 i 再加 est。
questions.e: happy → happier → happiest。

questions.q: good 的最高級是哪一個？
questions.e: good → better → best。

questions.q: beautiful 的最高級是哪一個？
questions.e: 長的形容詞用 the most：the most beautiful。

questions.q: Tom is the ___ boy in our class.
h: in our class 是全班比較。
questions.e: 全班三人以上比較，用 the + 最高級。

questions.q: The elephant is the ___ of the three animals.
h: of the three 是三個比較。
big 的最高級要重複 g。
questions.e: 三個比較用最高級：the biggest。

questions.q: 「Who is the youngest in your family?」最適合的回答是哪一個？
questions.e: 問誰最年輕，回答 My little sister is.

questions.q: bad 的最高級是哪一個？
questions.e: bad → worse → worst。

questions.q: Which is the ___ of the three: a bike, a car or a plane?
questions.e: 三者比較用最高級：the fastest（飛機最快）。

questions.q: 兩個東西比較用比較級，三個以上比較用最高級。
h: the tallest 是三個以上比。
questions.e: 兩者比較用比較級（-er than），三者以上用最高級（the -est）。

questions.q: This is the ___ day of my life!
h: the ... of my life，是一生中最……
questions.e: the best day of my life 我這輩子最棒的一天。

concepts.title: 問路與指路
concepts.summary: turn left、go straight、next to、between……學會問路和指路。

questions.q: 「向左轉」英文要怎麼說？
questions.e: turn left 左轉；turn right 右轉。

questions.q: go straight 是什麼意思？
questions.e: go straight 直直往前走。

questions.q: next to 是什麼意思？
h: The bank is next to the park.
questions.e: next to 在……旁邊。

questions.q: The bank is ___ the park and the school.
h: 銀行在公園和學校中間。
questions.e: between A and B 在 A 和 B 之間。

questions.q: across from 是什麼意思？
questions.e: across from 在……對面。

questions.q: 「Excuse me. How can I get to the post office?」最適合的回答是哪一個？
questions.e: How can I get to ...? 是問路，回答走法：直走再右轉。

questions.q: The library is ___ Main Street.
questions.e: 在某條街上用 on：on Main Street。

questions.q: near 是什麼意思？
h: The station is near my home.
questions.e: near 在附近；far from 離……很遠。

questions.q: hospital 是什麼地方？
questions.e: hospital 醫院；post office 郵局；bank 銀行；library 圖書館。

questions.q: Where can you buy medicine?
questions.e: drugstore 藥局，可以買藥。

questions.q: turn right 的意思是「向右轉」。
questions.e: turn right 右轉。

questions.q: 「The museum is behind the park.」博物館在公園的哪裡？
questions.e: behind 在……後面；in front of 在……前面。

concepts.title: 身體不舒服
concepts.summary: What's wrong? I have a headache. 學會說哪裡不舒服、該怎麼做。

questions.q: 「What's wrong?」最適合的回答是哪一個？
questions.e: What's wrong? 怎麼了？→ I have a headache. 我頭痛。

questions.q: headache 是什麼意思？
questions.e: head（頭）+ ache（痛）= 頭痛。

questions.q: stomachache 是什麼意思？
questions.e: stomach（肚子）+ ache（痛）= 肚子痛。

questions.q: I have a toothache. I should see a ___.
questions.e: 牙痛要去看牙醫 dentist。

questions.q: 「I have a cold.」是什麼意思？
h: have a cold 是一種小病。
questions.e: have a cold 感冒；I'm cold 才是我很冷。

questions.q: fever 是什麼意思？
questions.e: fever 發燒；cough 咳嗽。

questions.q: You have a fever. You should ___ more water.
questions.e: 發燒要多喝水：drink more water。

questions.q: 「You should see a doctor.」是什麼意思？
h: see a doctor 是看醫生。
questions.e: You should see a doctor. 你應該去看醫生。

questions.q: 「I feel sick.」是什麼意思？
questions.e: I feel sick. 我覺得不舒服。

questions.q: 「Take some medicine and get some rest.」是在建議對方做什麼？
questions.e: take medicine 吃藥；get some rest 休息一下。

questions.q: Don't eat too much candy, or you'll get a ___.
questions.e: 吃太多糖會蛀牙、牙痛：toothache。

questions.q: 「I have a cough.」的意思是「我在咳嗽」。
h: have a cough 有咳嗽的症狀。
questions.e: I have a cough. 我咳嗽。

concepts.title: 職業與夢想
concepts.summary: What do you want to be? 認識各種職業，說說自己的夢想。

questions.q: teacher 是什麼職業？
questions.e: teach（教）+ er = teacher 老師。

questions.q: Where does a doctor work?
questions.e: 醫生在醫院工作：in a hospital。

questions.q: Who grows rice and vegetables?
questions.e: farmer 農夫，種稻米和蔬菜。

questions.q: police officer 是什麼職業？
questions.e: police officer 警察。

questions.q: Who cooks food in a restaurant?
questions.e: cook 也可以當名詞：廚師。

questions.q: firefighter 是什麼職業？
questions.e: firefighter 和火災對抗的人：消防員。

questions.q: 「What does your father do?」最適合的回答是哪一個？
h: What does ... do? 是問職業。
questions.e: What does he do? 問職業 → He's a bus driver. 他是公車司機。

questions.q: 「What do you want to be?」最適合的回答是哪一個？
questions.a: I want to be a pilot.
questions.e: What do you want to be? 你將來想當什麼？→ I want to be a pilot.

questions.q: A pilot ___ airplanes.
questions.e: pilot 飛行員駕駛飛機：flies airplanes。

questions.q: nurse 是什麼職業？
questions.e: nurse 護理師，照顧病人、協助醫生。

questions.q: My dog is sick. I take him to see a ___.
questions.e: vet 獸醫，幫動物看病。

questions.q: Who brings letters to your home?
questions.e: mail carrier 郵差，把信送到家。

concepts.title: 頻率副詞
concepts.summary: always > usually > sometimes > never，說說你多常做一件事。

questions.q: always 是什麼意思？
questions.e: always 總是（100%）。

questions.q: never 是什麼意思？
questions.e: never 從不（0%）。

questions.q: sometimes 是什麼意思？
questions.e: sometimes 有時候。

questions.q: usually 是什麼意思？
questions.e: usually 通常。

questions.q: 下列哪一個頻率最高？
questions.e: always > usually > sometimes > never。

questions.q: 我每天睡前都刷牙：I ___ brush my teeth before bed.
questions.e: 每天都做用 always。

questions.q: 「How often do you play basketball?」最適合的回答是哪一個？
questions.e: How often 問頻率 → Twice a week. 一週兩次。

questions.q: once a week 是什麼意思？
questions.e: once 一次、twice 兩次；once a week 一週一次。

questions.q: 下列哪一句的詞序正確？
h: 頻率副詞通常放在一般動詞前面。
questions.e: 頻率副詞放在一般動詞前面、be 動詞後面。

questions.q: 「I never eat breakfast.」是什麼意思？
questions.e: never 從不：我從來不吃早餐。

questions.q: He is ___ late for school. He gets up very early.
questions.e: 很早起床，所以從不遲到：He is never late.

questions.q: sometimes 的意思是「每一次都」。
questions.e: sometimes 是有時候；每一次都是 always。
